# Story bank

## S1. Rebuilt the society's payments sheet
- Best for: initiative, problem solving, attention to detail
- Evidence:
  - Treasurer of the student investing society for one year
  - Replaced a hand-kept spreadsheet with a script that reconciled 400 member payments
  - Found 12 payments recorded twice
- Anchors: treasurer, 400 payments, duplicate entries, script, reconciled monthly
- Gaps: how long the old process took each month; who signed off the change

## S2. Shop-floor rota conflict
- Best for: teamwork, conflict
- Evidence: Weekend supervisor at a supermarket; two staff swapped shifts without telling anyone
- Anchors: rota, weekend, swap, rule, no gaps
- Gaps: none

## S3 Data project on loan defaults
- Evidence: Final-year project predicting loan defaults with logistic regression
- Anchors: logistic regression; class imbalance; AUC 0.78
